description:
A scientific breakthrough as scientists create a "copper sandwich" molecule - it's Cuprocene. More links and info in full description ↓↓↓

Discussed here by Professor Sir Martyn Poliakoff.

See the paper - Isolable Cuprocenes: Bis(tri-tert-butylcyclopentadienyl) Complexes of Copper - https://doi.org/10.1021/jacs.5c19366

Our thanks to William (Bill) Evans for the images. Thanks also to Stephen Argent for helping with the animation.
